name: loadcraft
description: Run load tests on LoadCraft from your editor: prepare source-grounded OpenAPI, AsyncAPI, journey and project-overview artifacts, then create, run and read load tests.

interface.shortDescription: Prepare artifacts and run load tests.
interface.longDescription: Inspect customer repositories and prepare a validated OpenAPI file, AsyncAPI file, grounded frontend journey descriptions, or a project overview for LoadCraft.
defaultPrompt: Prepare this API repository for LoadCraft.
Create LoadCraft journeys from this frontend.
Describe this application's asynchronous API for LoadCraft.
Write a LoadCraft project overview for this repository.
